categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of lithium battery modules. Its main product lines include lightweight electric vehicle battery modules (for e-bikes, e-motorcycles, and balance vehicles) and medium to large industrial energy storage system battery modules. It also plans to develop battery modules for warehouse equipment and electric vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced lithium battery module technology, including high-power battery design, structural strength enhancement, waterproofing, and compliance with automotive safety standards such as AUTOSAR and ISO26262. It employs automated production processes and continuous process improvements to enhance product quality and production efficiency. The company also integrates software and hardware compatibility for customized e-bike battery modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are international leading brands in lightweight electric vehicles, industrial energy storage, and data center backup power systems. Major markets include Europe, Japan, and the Americas, with growing demand driven by green energy policies and the expansion of data centers requiring reliable energy storage solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases in China (Changshu) and Taiwan (Hsinchu), with sales and market presence primarily in Europe, Japan, the Americas, and Asia. It has subsidiaries and offices in the Cayman Islands, Hong Kong, the USA, Singapore, and Vietnam to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, focusing on battery module assembly and customization. It sources battery cells mainly from upstream suppliers in Japan and South Korea and supplies finished battery modules to downstream manufacturers of electric vehicles and energy storage systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the lightweight electric vehicle and industrial energy storage markets, developing high-voltage and communication battery modules for 5G applications, and enhancing automotive battery safety and software platforms. The company plans to invest about 9% of revenue in R&D to innovate and diversify its product portfolio, including customized e-bike battery modules and automotive batteries compliant with international standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of lithium battery modules to OEM customers in the electric vehicle and industrial energy storage sectors. The company emphasizes customized product development and after-sales service to maintain customer relationships and market share.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Bosch, BMZ, Panasonic, and other international battery module manufacturers. The company holds a competitive position as a key supplier to leading global brands, recognized for high product quality, efficient production, and strong R&D capabilities, particularly in the lightweight electric vehicle segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately NT$15 billion in 2022, representing a 30.3% increase over the previous year. It has shown consistent growth in sales, gross profit, and net income, supported by expanding production capacity and market demand. Total assets reached NT$19.5 billion with a 31.2% increase year-over-year, reflecting ongoing investments in fixed assets and inventory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through superior product quality, rapid delivery, strong customization capabilities, and advanced R&D in lithium battery technology. It maintains cost advantages through process improvements and scale economies, while emphasizing environmental sustainability and compliance with international safety and environmental standards. Its close collaboration with global customers and strategic supply chain management further enhance its competitive edge.
